summary.zh-CN: 应用市场现在可以随目录规模增长，并通过可离开的后台安装、更新、回滚和卸载提供完整生命周期。
summary.en-US: Scales app discovery and adds leave-behind background installs, updates, rollbacks, and uninstalls across the full app lifecycle.

body.zh-CN: 按需加载应用页，并在 Registry 中完成搜索与分类，无需把完整目录下载到客户端。
body.en-US: Loads app pages on demand and runs search and categories in the Registry instead of downloading the full catalog.

body.zh-CN: 安装、更新、回滚和卸载拥有统一进度；关闭弹窗或离开 Apps 不会中断操作。
body.en-US: Installs, updates, rollbacks, and uninstalls share progress and continue after the dialog or Apps view is closed.

body.zh-CN: 内置应用可以卸载并从官方应用库重新安装，同时继续保留本地个人数据。
body.en-US: Built-in apps can be uninstalled and reinstalled from the official library while personal data stays local.

body.zh-CN: 应用卡片和详情页使用真实图标与封面，并显示精选状态、来源和版本。
body.en-US: Cards and detail views use real icons and covers alongside featured state, publisher, and version.

body.zh-CN: 工作区文件上下文保持连续，排队发送的消息会立即确认。
body.en-US: Workspace file context stays continuous, and queued messages acknowledge submission immediately.

body.zh-CN: 修复损坏图片、无反馈的版本切换、缺少卸载入口和分类切换布局跳动。
body.en-US: Fixes broken artwork, silent version switching, missing uninstall actions, and layout shifts between categories.

body.zh-CN: 新旧目录接口可以在升级期间协同工作，不再把可用市场误报为不可用。
body.en-US: New and existing catalog endpoints work together during rollout without falsely reporting an unavailable marketplace.

body.zh-CN: 既有 .napp 包、公开安装链接与本地应用数据继续可用。
body.en-US: Existing .napp packages, public install links, and local app data remain usable.
